cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the complaints to the chair. I hid the first letter in my drawer. Where's the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're actually going to admit hiding it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put mine on top and say whose drawer it was. You can hand yours over without speaking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the third one too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put both behind mine. I'll explain the order; you only have to tell me when each arrived.
